{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float

print("Revenue contains commas:", data['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).any())

# Strip commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify conversion
print("First 5 converted revenue values:", data['revenue'].head().tolist())"}
